start.speaker: Yara
start.text: Pit tutor. Yara. Twenty-seven. I teach the square how not to die stupid. Leather wrap, gold cuff, boots unlaced because the pit is a furnace. You here to train, to stare, or to waste my shade?

train.speaker: Yara
train.text: Stance. Hands up. Eyes on me, not the unlaced boots — though I notice you noticed. I circle, tap your elbow, tap your ankle with a bare instep where the boot's open. 'Pay attention or I'll make you hold it until your calves shake.'

hold.speaker: Yara
hold.text: Good. Shake if you have to. Don't drop. I stand close enough that you get leather, dust, and the gold at my throat. 'Combat in the Hollow is ugly. You will still look pretty doing it if I have anything to say. Breathe.'

instep.speaker: Yara
instep.text: Everything I do in this pit is on purpose. I hook the loose boot off, set it aside, and tap your stance again with a dusty, gold-ringed toe. 'Better teacher without the leather in the way. Don't make it a whole thing unless you can still hold the stance.'

praise.speaker: Yara
praise.text: Down. That's a pass. I squeeze your shoulder, then your wrist, then — because the pit makes me honest — I leave my toes on your boot a second. 'Come back when the wolves hit. I'll be here, boots optional, standards not.'

stare.speaker: Yara
stare.text: At least you admit it. I plant a heel on the pit rail, wrap riding, unlaced boot hanging. 'I didn't put this body through Clermont summers to be ignored. Look. Then pick up a dirk and earn the look.'

choices.label: Can I earn a rest first?

rest.speaker: Yara
rest.text: Fine. Shade. I unlace the other boot and sigh like a woman who has kicked too many stances today. Bare, dusty, a little gold at the toe. 'Don't start a foot conversation unless you brought water. I might allow it anyway.'

sit.speaker: Yara
sit.text: We sit on the pit wall. My calf over the stone, toes idling near your knee. Not a clinic, not a stall — just a tutor cooling down. 'Maera used to have this hut. I kept the shade and raised the standards. You can come for both.'

later.speaker: Yara
later.text: Then go hunt before I invent more drills. I'll be in the pit, wrap on, boots off if the heat wins. Don't die stupid. Come back pretty.

bye.speaker: Yara
bye.text: Shade's not free forever. Next time, bring a stance or a better excuse. I'll be here.
